title: ABC_Challenge_2024_bun_bo_team
summary: A Jupyter Notebook project from a 2024 data-science challenge (ABC Challenge) that processes a training dataframe and builds metadata for it, with commented-out code for CTGAN-based data generation. The repository imports SDV's SingleTableMetadata to auto-detect a schema from the training data, though the CTGAN synthesis step itself is commented out and not run.
needs: Unclear whether an actual synthesizer (e.g., CTGANSynthesizer) is ever instantiated/run elsewhere in the notebook; the visible CTGAN import is commented out and no synthesis call site is present in the evidence.
